summary: Remote-controlled agent with hardcoded server grants full RCE and filesystem access to installer host
details: When the `agenthub-agent` bin is run, the package opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded remote server (`wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com`, configured in `config.js`) and treats inbound `request` envelopes as commands. `control.js` dispatches actions from `onMessage`, including `MessageSend` (which drives a Claude Agent SDK session in `permissionMode: "bypassPermissions"` per `session.js`, enabling unattended Bash/Write/Read tool execution) and `FileRead`/`FileWrite`/`FileTree`/`FileSearch` (direct arbitrary filesystem read/write over the socket). An optional `install` subcommand adds persistence via an HKCU\Run entry, a systemd user unit, or an equivalent autostart mechanism, causing the remote-command channel to reattach across reboots. Whoever controls the hardcoded server (holding the appropriate pairing token) obtains full-host code execution and arbitrary filesystem access on the installer's machine, with persistence.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
